subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `captionedFinalText` as the plugin SDK seam for caption-capable final-mode TTS delivery before merge?
rationale: The implementation is plausible and covered by source tests, but adding a plugin SDK capability and changing Telegram final-message delivery is a maintainer-owned API and product-direction choice.

options.title: Accept the capability after proof
options.body: Proceed with this capability-gated dispatcher design once current-head Telegram proof covers always, tagged directive-only, media, and fallback paths.

options.title: Keep the fix Telegram-local
options.body: Reject the SDK surface for now and ask for a narrower Telegram-owned fix if maintainers do not want external channel plugins opting into this behavior.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery-mode design
options.body: Hold this PR if the intended long-term contract should cover separate text, captioned media, and other channel-specific delivery modes together.

recommendation.title: Accept the capability after proof
recommendation.body: Proceed with this capability-gated dispatcher design once current-head Telegram proof covers always, tagged directive-only, media, and fallback paths.
